brand.description: Soap Gold is a UK soaps heritage fan site celebrating Emmerdale and Coronation Street history: classic storylines retold properly, anniversaries marked, iconic characters celebrated, and the sets and locations fans still visit today.
brand.name: Soap Gold
brand.tagline: The soaps you grew up with — their greatest stories, told properly.

categories.description: The greatest Emmerdale and Coronation Street storylines ever broadcast, retold properly from the original episodes — who did what, why it mattered, and how it ended.
categories.name: Classic Storylines Retold

categories.description: What happened on this day in soap history: first episodes, famous exits, weddings, disasters and the moments everyone still talks about.
categories.name: On This Day

categories.description: The characters who made the soaps — and the actors who played them: profiles, best moments and where-are-they-now features.
categories.name: Iconic Characters

categories.description: Round-number anniversaries, episode-count milestones and landmark moments from more than half a century of the Dales and the cobbles.
categories.name: Anniversaries & Milestones

categories.description: The famous sets, villages and locations behind the soaps — how they were built, how they changed, and how fans can visit them today.
categories.name: Sets, Locations & Tours

writer.bio: Soap Gold is written by lifelong soap fans, for lifelong soap fans. The team retells the classic Emmerdale and Coronation Street storylines from the original broadcasts, listings and cast interviews — celebrating the history of the soaps you grew up with, and always labelling a theory as a theory.
writer.name: Soap Gold Team
